sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of proceeds ​ ​ We expect to receive approximately $12.5 million in net proceeds from the sale of Ordinary Shares offered by us in this offering (approximately $14.7 million if the Representative exercises its over-allotment option in full), based upon an assumed public offering price of $7.00 per Ordinary Share, which is the midpoint of the price range set forth on the cover page of this prospectus, and after deducting the underwriting discount and estimated offering expenses payable by us. We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering (i) to acquire new OEM customers; (ii) for R&D; (iii) to expand our business with existing OEM customers; (iv) to strengthen our relationships with Tier-1 and semiconductor partners; (v) to expand into adjacent markets; and (vi) for working capital and general corporate purposes. sections.excerpt: Risk factors ​ ​ Investing in our securities involves a high degree of risk.
